resolution.note: cache accepts only ghs_+36 alnum; test runner isolates KRN_APP_CACHE_DIR per worker; planted ghs_token12 replaced by fresh mint

title: The app-token cache writer is found and the cache accepts only a 40-char ghs_ token
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-15 23:40: after #1112 (t-j8magk5) merged, .krn/tmp/app-cache/krn-app-token.json again held a planted token, now 11 chars with the ghs_ prefix and expiry 2027-01-15, so the ghs_ guard passed it; S26 ship push failed exit 70 twice; lead deleted the cache. test/claude/github-app-token.test.ts isolates its env (exec passes only PATH + fixture env), so the writer is elsewhere: a lane-run, successor, adopt/init or outside-acceptance test or script that mints through a stub and inherits KRN_APP_CACHE_DIR.
Outcome: the writer is found and isolated, and the cache rejects a token that is not ghs_ plus 36 alphanumerics (40 chars); a 24h soak with lanes running leaves the cache valid (0 push exit 70).
Proof: test plants ghs_token12 in KRN_APP_CACHE_DIR and mint returns a fresh stub token; grep of every test env that spawns bin/krn shows KRN_APP_CACHE_DIR overridden.
Files: src/ci/app-token.ts, test/claude/github-app-token.test.ts
